cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did 'office furniture' hurt you? When I trained you to write incident reports, I said to name the effect, not just quote the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still drafting. You're good at spotting where a report will go. First tell me what it did to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. Twelve years here, and that's all I am.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's clearer than 'unprofessional'. Mine says that. I'll change it to 'I went home and cried'. Could you read it before I send it?

reason: Use familiar training and pupil corrections as the method of the exact emotional pursuit; preserve partner contribution, acknowledge real responsibility, and avoid claiming every setback was a planned lesson.
